exploratory_cluster.selection_rule: Select the most common joint pair of per-wallet dominant hold bucket and dominant width bucket among preregistered profitable wallets; ties are lexical and never use PnL magnitude.

prospective_policy.entry_signal: first strictly post-freeze finalized Meteora DLMM add_liquidity2 by any trigger wallet
prospective_policy.pool_universe: SOL-paired, non-blacklisted, TVL>=50000 USD, 24h volume>=25000 USD
source_action_requirements: observed source range span exactly 70 bins
prospective_policy.paper_position: mirror the source wallet's exact 70-bin SOL distribution weights, scaled to 0.1 SOL paper capital on the post-signal finalized pool state
prospective_policy.rebalance_policy: none; later source-wallet actions do not alter the paper position
prospective_policy.exit: withdraw at 491 seconds and liquidate residual token inventory to SOL using verified market state
result_requirements: verified finalized entry state after signal
complete verified forward market evidence through exit
no retrospective signal or threshold changes

interpretation: Exploratory only. The preregistered two-thirds repeatability gate failed, so this candidate is not confirmatory evidence; prospective results determine whether the modal wallet behavior merits further study.
